payload.text: CAPABILITY (carry-seam deliverable, smile-family reach): build_model_smile is the single pure selector that reaches all FIVE smile families through one contract — MarketHedge (vanna-volga market-hedge), StochasticVol (SABR), Parametric (SVI), ParametricSurface (SSVI), ExtendedSurface (eSSVI) — each routed to its calibrator (build_smile/fit_sabr/fit_svi/fit_ssvi/fit_essvi) and wrapped in the typed CalibratedSmile, with no calibration leaking outside the match. Pure: derives the CalibratedSmile from (model, ctx, quotes) refs with no WRITES; self-invalidates if a family arm acquires a side effect.
